name: Square-Amalgam Obstruction
definition: The displayed class in $Q_6$ whose low-bit vertex-incidence mask is `0xdf1b101000111011`; bit $j$ records the word with integer encoding $j$.
properties: An 18-vertex VC-dimension-two obstruction to the cover-recursively peripheral class. Its unique proper gated two-cover is a square sum of two eleven-vertex factors and is face-critical.
